items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: He took me to Europe, and was a very, very nice tour.

ctx.x: That's very important, Red, because with all the big bands I had been with, none of them were able
to take me to Europe. But Red did. He promised me, and asked me if I wanted to go. And in fact, this was after I had had pneumonia.
